_gate_compatibility_note: IMPORTANT CROSS-CHECK FINDING: qa/compose.py's pick_turnaround() keyword-matches costume_state text against a hardcoded donor-specific vocabulary ('corset'->t8, 'lab coat'->t3, tier>=7->t9, torn/remnant/shred/tear/split->'torn', 'suit'->t6_suit, 'blouse'+tier>=4->t4, 'blouse'/'reporter'/tier<=2->t2). Heather & Mark's costume vocabulary (t-shirts, tanks, shorts, jeans, swimsuits) matches NONE of these keywords except the torn/shred/tear regex (which does fire correctly for the several genuinely-torn panels, e.g. 042/043/046/047/065/068) and the tier>=7 branch (which never fires -- this project's tiers only run 0-5). For every OTHER panel, pick_turnaround() would fall through to 'D4: ambiguous turnaround' and REFUSE unless the panel's qa/staging/<id>.json file supplies an explicit turnaround_key override (pick_turnaround() checks staging.get(char,{}).get('turnaround_key') FIRST, before any keyword logic, and returns it directly if present). This is true even for SOLO (1-character) panels, which compose_page() does not otherwise require a staging file for -- meaning path A (page: reroll) is actually broken for MOST of this project's panels without an override, a gap beyond what qa-scaffold-PLAN.md section 6 already flagged. Not a reason to modify compose.py (out of scope, and the recommended fix is the separate edit: job kind in proposed-compose-edit-kind.diff) -- flagging here so a future reader of this ledger understands why turnaround_key values below won't auto-resolve.
